shill_context: grab /run/autotest_pause_ethernet_hook, not shill-start.lock shill-start.lock is a subset of /run/autotest_pause_ethernet_hook, but much less useful. We're going to kill it, so migrate over. While no actively-running tests still use 'stopped_shill', it's still nice to avoid misleading references to it. While I'm at it, let's use an exclusive lock, not a shared lock. We don't want or expect multiple tests to be active like this, but when we do have a non-test user playing with connectivity (e.g., moblab network init), we do still want exclusion. Remove self-referential content-refresh line In the beginning, go/faft was a Google Doc. Then we put its contents into a markdown file, and added a line declaring when the content had last been refreshed from go/faft.
